concerns.text: Tasks T001, T002, T003, and T010 are marked `[X]` (completed) despite the 'Analyze Report' explicitly stating these artifacts were rejected/missing. This creates a semantic weakening of the 'Reproducibility' (Constitution I) and 'Data Hygiene' (Constitution III) constraints by falsely asserting the foundation is ready when it is not.

Tasks T016 and T017 are marked `[X]` despite the 'Analyze Report' confirming no execution logs or data files exist for the 10,000 time-step run. This violates FR-002 (execute 10k steps) and SC-005 (memory footprint verification) by claiming the deliverable is complete without the required evidence, effectively weakening the acceptance criteria.

Task T032 is marked `[X]` despite the 'Analyze Report' stating no code or output exists for the partial correlation analysis. This violates SC-006 (independence of metrics) and FR-007 (ACF validation) by asserting the constraint is satisfied when the specific validation logic is absent.

Task T026 is marked `[X]` (implied) despite the rejection of T016. Since T026 requires raw data from T016 to run, marking it complete creates a logical impossibility and silently drops the acceptance criterion of 'recording metrics' for the parameter sweep, violating FR-002 and FR-004.

Task T031 (latency reduction calculator) is marked `[ ]` but depends on T016 (marked `[X]` falsely). The task list implies the verification of SC-001 (≥90% latency reduction) is pending, but the upstream data it relies on is falsely marked as present, creating a silent drift in the verification chain.
